note: Registry of third-party organizations JVTO refers to. The @id base is the JVTO domain on purpose: the @id identifies *JVTO's reference to* the entity, not the entity itself. Ownership is asserted through sameAs. Never add a sameAs URL without verifying it — leave it empty and mark evidenceStatus 'candidate' instead. A node with an @id and no sameAs is still far better than an anonymous node, because the @id is what consolidates the entity across pages.

records.canonicalName: Balai Besar KSDA Jawa Timur (BBKSDA Jawa Timur)
records.sourceNote: Regulator of TWA Ijen and issuer of SE.1658/KSA.9/2024, the regulation behind the mandatory health screening. It existed only as a fragment of the string 'HPWKI — supervised by BBKSDA Jawa Timur' and had no node of its own, despite being JVTO's most load-bearing authority asset. No sameAs in the repo yet. Defined on /verify-jvto/legal rather than the health-screening page: it is reached only through HPWKI's regulator relation, and defining it on a page that never names it left a dangling @id.
